item.title: Good Morning Family - 21 July 2026
item.description:
Wakey Wakey breakfast crew!
Hello everyone!
Today is Tuesday, the 21 July.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 4 degrees and a top of 12 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is T.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter T?
. . . . . . . . . . . . . .
